description: She wears an opaque teal-blue floor-length fitted gown with a low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves, richly edged with gold knot and animal-motif woven borders. A narrow cream underdress shows through the front skirt opening. A broad cream wrap with gold animal motifs and teal-gold borders lies loosely around her forearms. The waist is belted with decorated gold-colored discs and a long hanging chain of round medallions, ending in elongated ornaments and a tassel. Gold chandelier earrings hang beside her cheeks. Dark brown closed-toe leather shoes are visible under the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
